design_status: Independent follow-up designed after inspecting the grid-geometry extension. The original 2 km width is retained; 16 grids are tested without claiming global optimality.
scope: Isotropic single hotspot with uniform background. All inputs paired across the two estimators. Calibration and testing use distinct seeds, and none of the geometry observations are reused. Three-width simultaneous one-sided confidence bounds are evaluated separately within each method, distance and side; mean-error comparisons are pointwise descriptive intervals.
